#summary Instructions for cross-compiling PARI/GP (2.5.0-STABLE) for Android.
#labels Featured

= Prerequisites =

  * PARI/GP (2.5.0-STABLE) source code.
  * Android NDK (`android-ndk-r6` or later).
  * Latest version of Android SDK.
  * `pari.cfg` file for Android.

= Preparing the Build Environment =

Cross-compiling PARI/GP for Android is somewhat tricky and involved. It is recommended to simply use the pre-compiled libraries and binary available on the downloads page.

If you wish to build PARI/GP from source for Android, follow these instructions.

If you wish to install the pre-compiled binaries, then you may skip down to the last section of this page now.

These instructions make use of the NDK as a standalone toolchain, which is a new feature in the latest version (`android-ndk-r6`) of the Android NDK. For simplicity, the target API level we use here is 3 (Android 1.5).

It is assumed at this point that the Android SDK/NDK have been installed according to the instructions found here: [http://developer.android.com/sdk/index.html]

It is also assumed that you have downloaded and extracted the PARI/GP source code and have the `pari.cfg` file from this website.

For brevity, the following short-hand will be used:

  * `$NDK` = path to NDK root directory.
   * e.g., `/opt/android/android-ndk-r6`
  * `$SDK` = path to SDK root directory.
   * e.g., `/opt/android/android-sdk-Linux_x86`
  * `$TOOLCHAIN` = path to Android toolchain.
   * e.g., `/tmp/android-toolchain`
  * `$SYSROOT` = path to Android toolchain sysroot.
   * e.g., `/tmp/android-toolchain/sysroot`
  * `$PARI` = path to PARI/GP source root directory.
   * e.g., `/build/pari/pari-2.5.0`

  == Setting up the NDK Toolchain ==

To setup the toolchain, simply run the following command:

`$NDK/build/tools/make-standalone-toolchain.sh --platform=android-3 --install-dir=/tmp/android-toolchain`

You can, of course, change the `install-dir` to whatever you like.

For more information, refer to the NDK Dev Guide documentation on "Using the NDK as a Standalone Toolchain".

When we build PARI/GP, the compiler will complain that the header file `$SYSROOT/usr/include/sys/termios.h`is missing. To resolve this, all you need to do is:

`cp $SYSROOT/usr/include/termios.h $SYSROOT/usr/include/sys/termios.h`

 == Cross-Compiling PARI/GP ==

  # Copy the `pari.cfg` file from this site such that it is immediately under the `$PARI` directory.
  # `cd $PARI`
  # Open `pari.cfg` in a text editor and set `TOP = '$PARI'`.
  # `./Configure -l pari.cfg`
  # `cd obj-dyn`
  # `make all`

It should take a few minutes to compile, and then you should have the following files located under `$PARI/obj-dyn`:

  * `libpari.so`
  * `libpari.a`
  * `libpari.so.3`
  * `libpari.so.2.5.0`
  * `gp-sta`
  * `gp-dyn`
